title: Achievement Heads
description: Adds a player head reward to every achievement
body:
This datapack gives you player heads after completing achievements.
using
```
/trigger claim
```
you can claim these heads.

you also get the recipe for the heads so you can craft more.
Every head has its own custom noteblock sound.

if you dont want the recipes to clutter up your recipe book you can do
```
/trigger hide_head_recipes
```
and if you want to see them again you can do 
```
/trigger show_head_recipes
```

It also adds 3 custom items

Hot tourist destinations:
bedrock remover
- a small bomb that removes bedrock, cause the glitch to do it is tedious

War pigs:
goblin boots
- boots that make you a bit smaller

Hero of the village:
endangering gold
- eat this gold to see all nearby mobs with a glowing effect for 5 seconds


Roadmap
- Adding missing achievements
- Optimizing how it updates
- Changing how the heads look in crafting
